meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 读取仓库里全部未关闭的 issue 和 PR，每条各起一个后台快速任务做分析，把带 GitHub 固定链接证据的报告写进 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录。全程只读：不发评论、不合并不关闭、不加标签。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词时触发，它接管整仓库的开放条目。

say.text: triage 这个仓库所有未关闭的 issue
say.note: 每条起一个后台任务，报告写入时间戳目录
只读分析，不会真的合并或评论
issue 和 PR 一起分析

howto.what_en: Reads every open issue and PR in the repo, spawns one background quick task per item, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{timestamp}/. Read-only: it never comments, merges, closes, or labels anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or similar phrases; it then takes over all open items in the repo.

say_en.text: triage all open issues in this repo
say_en.note: One background task per item; reports go to a timestamped /tmp folder
Read-only analysis; nothing is merged or commented on
Issues and PRs are analyzed together
